description: List the notes of one chord symbol as piano pitches, lowest first, built up from the root in the chosen octave (a slash bass goes below). Returns each note with its name, octave and MIDI number, plus a link to the browser chord finder. Gives pitches only, not voicings over time or rhythm.

octave.description: Octave of the root note in scientific pitch notation; 4 puts a C root on middle C.

symbol.description: One chord symbol such as "C", "F#m7", "Bbmaj7", "Gsus4" or "D/F#". Returns an error for symbols it cannot read.

name: spell_piano_chord

browserTool.description: Link to the matching free browser tool on clefdrills.com, to share with the user.

notes.description: Chord tones from lowest to highest.

name.description: Scientific pitch name, for example "C4" or "F#3".

octave.description: Octave number in scientific pitch notation.

title: Spell Piano Chord
